snippet.title: Cassette Beasts 2002 | Launch Window and Voice Actor Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We're launching across all supported platforms in March of next year - Learn all about our talented voice actors and some new characters in this new trailer unveiled at the Xbox Showcase at Gamescom! Set in London in 2002, play single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist threatening the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802140/Cassette_Beasts_2002/
Xbox Series S|X and Xbox on PC: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9mt18cxtnfxn
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019618/
Nintendo Switch 2: Coming Soon

ABOUT CASSETTE BEASTS, Launched 2023
Cassette Beasts, the open-world RPG that lets you collect and transform into awesome monsters in thrilling turn-based battles, is available on PC Steam, Microsoft Store, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Xbox Game Pass, and Nintendo Switch. Dive in today and discover why this imaginative journey of exploration and friendship is one of the best-reviewed games of 2023!
